Where each part lives and which cables share each run (from the model's runs, E8). Circuits on E2–E7 and E9; routes to scale on E8, E10–E15.
System overview: locations and cable bundles
Generated by tools/wiring/diagram.py from cad/fitout/wiring.py — cable IDs and lengths
match bom/cable-schedule-v0.13.csv. Measurements still [EST] until confirmed on the vehicle.
230 V work: licensed electrician only (AS/NZS 3000 · AS/NZS 3001.2). Not certified.

Every cable that leaves the tub goes out through the factory 240 V
outlet hole (passenger rear wall) and along the passenger chassis rail.
Nothing passes through the load lid.
The tent harness (dashed) unplugs at the gap junction, so the tent
lifts off with its services box and solar.
All switching is at the rear panel: battery isolate (S1 → QS1),
230 V never shares a conduit or gland row with 12 V.
Line weight ∝ number of cables in the run.
